recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If further cleanup is desired, update the OO Incubator DeviceUsage source so bodyStructure requirements prose aligns with the CodeableReference(BodyStructure) type instead of editing inactive FHIR core source/deviceusage files.
issue_request: FHIR-24680 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R5. It requested changing DeviceUseStatement.bodySite from CodeableConcept to a BodyStructure-capable representation, with the approved resolution proposing bodySite[x] CodeableConcept plus Reference(BodyStructure) and a Jira comment suggesting CodeableReference.
initial_application: Commit ce5720447c explicitly names FHIR-24680 and changes DeviceUseStatement.bodySite to CodeableReference(BodyStructure); commit 8e3a45ff18 preserves that shape while completing DeviceUseStatement updates. Retained source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml currently has DeviceUsage.bodyStructure as CodeableReference targeting BodyStructure.
additional_context: FHIR-26308 later accepted the implicit/pre-applied DeviceUsage changes made around FHIR-24680, and FHIR-53203 later renamed OO bodySite-style content to bodyStructure CodeableReference. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed DeviceUsage from active fhir.ini build/resource lists and changed the core device module to link DeviceUsage to the OO Incubator IG. The OO Incubator package currently contains DeviceUsage.bodyStructure as CodeableReference(BodyStructure), though its requirements prose still contains an older bodySite-extension sentence that would need external-source cleanup if the work group wants it corrected.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR core source was changed because DeviceUsage/DeviceUseStatement is no longer an active core build resource; editing retained source/deviceusage files would not change the current core specification.
